spots.name: Sükhbaatar Square
spots.summary: Sükhbaatar Square is the central square of Ulaanbaatar, the capital of Mongolia. The square was named for Mongolian revolutionary hero Damdin Sükhbaatar after his death in 1923, and features a monumental equestrian statue of him in its center.

spots.name: Gandantegchinlen Monastery

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Gandantegchinlen Monastery, also known as Gandan Monastery, is a Buddhist monastery in Bayangol District, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. It was founded in 1809, closed amid persecutions in 1939, and from 1944 to 1989 was the country's only active monastery. Today, it is the center of Buddhism in Mongolia.

spots.name: National Museum of Mongolia
spots.summary: The National Museum of Mongolia formerly known as the National Museum of Mongolian History is a history museum focusing on Mongolian history located in Chingeltei, Ulaanbaatar.

spots.name: Zaisan Memorial
spots.summary: The Zaisan Memorial is a memorial in Khan-Uul, Ulaanbaatar, the capital city of Mongolia, that honors allied Mongolian and Soviet soldiers killed in World War II.

spots.name: Choijin Lama Temple
spots.summary: The Choijin Lama Temple is a Buddhist monastery in Sükhbaatar District, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

spots.name: Sükhbaatar's Mausoleum
spots.summary: Sükhbaatar's Mausoleum, sometimes referred to as Sükhbaatar's and Choibalsan's Mausoleum, was a mausoleum located at Sükhbaatar Square in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

spots.name: Mongolian State Academic Theatre of Opera and Ballet
spots.summary: The Mongolian State Academic Theatre of Opera and Ballet is a theater on the eastern side of Sükhbaatar Square in Sükhbaatar District. It was established on 15 May 1963 as the State Musical Drama Theatre.

spots.name: National Sports Stadium
spots.summary: National Sports Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Khan Uul District, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. It is used mostly for football matches and has a capacity of 12,500. The Naadam festival, which celebrates Mongolian independence, is held there every July.

spots.name: Fountain Square
spots.summary: The Fountain Square or Beatles Square is a town square in Sükhbaatar, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

spots.name: Mongolian Theatre Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Mongolian Theatre Museum was founded in 1991 to preserve and present the traditions and artifacts of the performing arts in Mongolia and to do research in this area. The museum is located in the Central Cultural Palace Building, on Amar Street, just off Sükhbaatar Square in Sükhbaatar District, Ulaanbaatar.

spots.summary: Patrons of this brewpub can choose between the main dining area, the fancy VIP upstairs, or secluded tables in the back. Most weekends have concerts from Mongolian bands. In addition to the house brews served on tap, the more popular Mongolian brands are served.

spots.name: California Restaurant

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Extensive menu of both foreign and Mongolian specialties. Beautifully decorated, high-quality food including vegetarian specialties (good tofu!) It's a bit small, but in the summer there is additional outside seating. Reservations are advised.

spots.name: Papa Cafe

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Burgers, chicken burgers, espresso and baked goods. On Saturday they open at 09:00 and serve a breakfast special of one large waffle with fresh fruit, ice cream, bacon, Mongolian blueberry jam and syrup, plus coffee and other drinks.

spots.name: Hazara North Indian Restaurant

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Serving spicy North Indian, Kashmiri, and Afghani food since 1997. Food is all halal, with vegan options available. Well-decorated restaurant and costumed waitresses can make you think you are in Delhi instead of Mongolia.

spots.name: Luna Blanca
spots.summary: Good-quality vegan food. Attached to a Buddhist meditation centre, therefore short opening hours (closes around 9pm).If you're looking to self-cater they also sell a modest selection of groceries including vegan sausages.

spots.name: Los Bandidos

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Mexican-Indian fusion: don't knock it until you taste the spicy chicken masala or crispy taquitos. The prices are higher now than they used to be, but the atmosphere has improved along with it.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: If you want to experience authentic Mongolian cuisine, this is the place. Serves roasted sheep head, roasted ribs, buuz, and dried meat soup. No foreign-language menu or staff, though.
